property_summary: For every caller and newOwner, transferOwnership must set owner exactly to newOwner; the mutant sets owner to msg.sender, breaking this for any newOwner != caller.

Calling owned() (by the rightful owner, after ownership was fuzz-transferred) must never change the owner, i.e. c.owner() stays equal to the owner that was set; the mutant's injected owner = msg.sender breaks this for inputs where the caller of owned() differs from the owner at call time, corrupting the owner visible via the public getter.

For any owner address and any caller, a call to owned() succeeds exactly when the caller is the current owner, and in that case the owner afterwards equals the caller (ownership is never silently rewritten to anyone else); the mutant's injected `owner = msg.sender` is meant to corrupt the owner visible via the public owner() getter when the caller of owned() differs from the owner at call time.

Ownership may only ever be set by transferOwnership to an explicitly supplied address: after bootstrapping the zero owner to a fuzzed actor and exercising owned() by that actor, a subsequent transferOwnership(t) must leave owner() exactly t; the mutant's injected owner = msg.sender rewrites the owner to the caller of owned(), corrupting the owner visible via the public getter whenever the caller differs from the last explicitly transferred owner.
